faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Is the free plan really free?
faq.a1: Yes — no card required. You can create up to {limit} invoices every calendar month.
faq.a2: Any invoice you save, draft or sent. Deleting an invoice does not restore monthly quota.
faq.a3: Until the term you paid for ends. After that you are on the free plan, and your invoices stay.
faq.q4: Do you take a cut of my invoice amounts?
faq.a4: Never. InvoiceFlow is a flat prepaid price. What your client pays is yours.
